finding: UVC phi is measured around the apex -> (MV+TV rim centroid) line. That line runs near the septum, not through the LV cavity, so phi is strongly non-uniform: the septum spans ~210 deg of phi and the free wall ~150. Site names and the Bazan superior/inferior split (sin phi >= 0) do not match the body or AHA segments. 'Lateral' (phi 180) sites are AHA inferolateral/inferior; 'inferolateral' (phi -120..-150) sites are inferior/inferoseptal; 4-5 positions per heart are labelled 'superior' but lie in the body-inferior half (phi 180 z0.75 or z0.5 positions, basal-ring-lateral vein sites, septal phi 0 sites, RCC cusp).

finding: Every pacing site is a ball of all nodes within 1.5 mm, activated at t = 0. On a ~1 mm mesh in a 4-5 mm RV wall (and a 1-2 mm cusp wall) this smears depth: RV 75 % and 90 % sites both touch the epicardium; 10 % sites always touch the endocardium and often a junction. The Bazan 2006 RV comparison is therefore compressed by construction. Not stated as a model assumption in the plan.
evidence: a06_sites.json: RV free wall: ball reaches endocardium at 9/9 10 % sites; reaches epicardium at 8-9/9 75 % and 90 % sites per heart. Aortic cusps Y5HYEDL4: wall 1.0-2.2 mm, ball reaches both surfaces at every depth. Subagent: 10 % balls contain a junction node in 17/15/10 of 36 sites; 90 % balls touch the endocardium in 9/9/8.
